dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Honorary Knight. I am categorizing the opponents we've encountered on our expeditions so far into five tiers based on their combat strength.

dialogues.speaker: Leifhelm
dialogues.text: The tiers, from the least powerful to the most, are: Pre-Captains, Captains, Super Captains, Pre-Masters, and Masters.
